request_modes.di-graph-noop: returns a constant without traversing the graph, isolating request-path impact of a larger constructed graph
request_modes.di-graph-traverse: recursively visits the complete injected graph and returns its node count; each node performs an observable atomic visit so release optimization cannot fold the traversal into a constant

dependency_graph.shape: balanced binary tree; every node is registered and reachable from the root controller

request_randomization.operation_order: independent transactions shuffled per worker; request sequences within a transaction remain ordered
request_randomization.seed_derivation: SHA-256 of master seed, workload, framework, run index, and dependency count
request_randomization.target_order: one randomized process/workload trial per schedule entry

transport_errors: oversized body: transport failure: ConnectionResetError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer
